title: ANDS Studio — Validation & eCTD export
walkthrough:
The "Draft completeness check" card carries this flow. Its header shows that label with a status chip on the right: "● NO STRUCTURAL ISSUES" when clean, or "● N issue(s)" when errors exist. On the face below sit the profile name and version, e.g. the criteria name then "v1.0" with "(structural; not HC eValidator)" inline, a "Ruleset synced: [date]" line when present, and a one-line disclaimer. Two ghost buttons follow, collapsed by default: "What this does / does NOT check" (expands into "Modeled on…", a "Checks (structure & format)" list, and a "Does NOT check" list) and "Rule catalogue (CA-E/CA-W ids)" (loads the live rules grouped by family, each id like CA-E-1001 with a plain description, warnings tagged "(warning)", and a "Source:" citation where present). A compact eCTD primer sits under this.

Findings are listed next. Each row shows a rule id, an "error" or "warning" chip, the failing leaf, and the message. Only the first 5 errors and 3 warnings show, with a "Show all N findings" toggle and, while collapsed, a "+N more warning(s)" note. When nothing is wrong you read "No presence/format issues found. This does not confirm scientific adequacy or full eCTD validity — run eValidator before transmission."

On a clean result an "eValidator handoff" section appears: a pinned banner stating "You must still run Health Canada's official eValidator before transmission," a next-step note (export, validate in HC's eValidator or your publisher's, then upload via CESG WebTrader), and a collapsed "Parity-gap table" expander mapping each rule family to an "overlaps" or "no HC counterpart" chip.

A quiet "Technical check & report" expander holds "Run technical check (PDF header/encryption)" (shows "Checking…" while running) and Download report (CSV / JSON / PDF) buttons, plus a footnote that this is a presence/format check, not a Health Canada review, and any checksum shown is document control (md5), not validation.

The "Application Viewer" page gives a read-only view of the assembled eCTD, with a "Files" / "Outline" tab bar and a "⬇ Export eCTD package" chip. Files lists each Canadian Module folder with its placed documents (📄 icon, title, then "href · md5 …") and a live-leaf/placement line; empty, it reads "No documents placed yet." Outline shows the sequence, its lifecycle-operation count, the operations, and an expandable "eCTD backbone (index.xml)." Export runs the check first: on success the zip downloads and a card pins the eValidator handoff again; if it fails, a red banner reads "Export blocked — the completeness check did not pass," names the issue count, and points you to fix the module pages or override from the Sequences panel.

The "Sequences" card (with a "working: NNNN" note) lists each sequence: its number, a purpose chip (Response, Supplement, Annual notification, Initial), a "N leaf(s)" count, an "● ACTIVE" badge or "Make active" button, and an "Export" button; where operations exist, per-sequence lifecycle-operator chips ("2× new", "1× replace") appear. "New sequence" opens a purpose dropdown, a note field, and "Create & make active" / "Cancel". On a block, an "Export blocked — sequence NNNN" panel states the reason, the profile checked, and up to 8 findings; "Export anyway (override)" stays disabled until you type a reason "recorded to the audit trail".
